reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Exceptional Craftsmanship and Customer Care
From start to finish, Cabinet Creations exceeded our expectations for our mudroom renovation. What truly stood out was the genuine care and attention the owners brought to every single detail of our project. This family owned business is authentic and deeply invested in their work. You can tell they take pride in what they create.

The owners were remarkably responsive and involved throughout the entire process, always available to answer questions, address concerns, and collaborate on design decisions. They never made us feel rushed or like we were an inconvenience. Beyond their responsiveness, the owners proved to be incredibly personable and kind. They took the time to understand our vision, offered knowledgeable suggestions based on their extensive experience, and guided us through choices with patience and expertise. Their professionalism combined with genuine warmth made the whole experience enjoyable.

The end result speaks for itself—our custom cabinets are absolutely stunning and surpassed what we had even imagined. The quality of craftsmanship is evident in every joint, finish, and detail. We will absolutely be using Cabinet Creations for future projects and highly recommend them to anyone seeking custom cabinetry. There is truly nothing negative to say about our experience. Thank you for your beautiful work! The pictures speak for themselves!

Wayne and his team are AMAZING. The team understands that cabinets are important to you, and that you invest a lot of emotion in the design process.  Wayne will work with you on your design until it’s exactly what you want.  Jennifer called us one day and said we could come “visit” our new kitchen as they were laying it out in their shop. : )  All of their customer service was outstanding, and the team is professional & friendly. They did our kitchen, bathroom, pantry and living room built-ins and it’s absolutely beautiful. And that pantry? Holy cow! Wayne made us a 8’ wide custom buffet in there that you wouldn’t believe.  I cannot say enough good things about Cabinet Creations.

Wayne and his team did such an amazing job on our closet.  The product is amazing, the design is well thought out and their service was amazing.  We are excited to talk to them about redoing our kitchen - one day soon.
